Thanks for the data — I pulled the relay logs for the onboarding host and the vendor-reported SAML snippets. Root cause: our fronting proxy (edge rewrite rule applied for multi-tenant vanity domains) is preserving X-Forwarded-Host and our SAML validation routine is strict — it compares the request host to the assertion Audience/Recipient and rejects when they differ. In this case Apex's email client or their network is rewriting the Host header to portal.apexfurnishings.com (their mail client preview service / security appliance) which ends up in the X-Forwarded-Host chain.

Remediation plan (short-medium term):
- Immediate: Ben can generate a one-time activation token and enable a non-SSO accept flow (manual accept + secure upload) for Apex. This is low-risk and reversible.
- Short term (next 48 hrs): we'll add a tolerant host-header check that accepts the canonical portal hostname when the request includes a trusted X-Originating-Email header or matches our partner onboarding domain pattern. This is a configuration change on the edge and SAML validation layer.
- Medium term: we'll add a normalization step to strip known proxy preview hosts from X-Forwarded-Host before assertion comparison and publish a KB entry describing the issue.

I will open an infra change ticket and aim to deploy the tolerant check to staging by EOD and prod by tomorrow morning. Risks: minor — broadened acceptance window only for the onboarding endpoint behind feature-flag; we will revert if any unexpected traffic patterns appear.

Ben — please create the manual activation link and set expiry 24 hours. Sofia — you can send that to Emily with instructions. I'll follow up once the config patch is live.

-David
